cases.purpose: Plain ASCII sentence with ASCII digits; baseline round trip.
One of three ids differing only by case; the database must keep all three distinct (no NOCASE, no lower()).
One of three ids differing only by case; must stay distinct from Ticket-ABC and TICKET-ABC.
One of three ids differing only by case; must stay distinct from the other two.
Dotless i (U+0131), dotted capital I (U+0130), i, I: locale-dependent case mapping must not alter or merge them.
Kelvin sign U+212A (singleton canonical equivalent of K); must stay distinct from the ASCII id K-id.
ASCII twin of the Kelvin sign id; case-insensitive or NFC folding would merge them.
Sharp s; full case folding turns it into ss and would collide with the next case.
Upper-case twin of the sharp s case; must stay distinct.
Precomposed e-acute (U+00E9); canonically equivalent to the next case but bytes differ; both must be stored distinct as ids and as text.
Decomposed e + U+0301; canonically equivalent to the previous case but bytes differ.
Angstrom sign U+212B, singleton canonical equivalent of U+00C5 (next case); NFC would rewrite it.
U+00C5 twin of the Angstrom sign; must stay distinct in bytes.
Astral code points (U+1F64F, U+1F44D + skin tone U+1F3FD); 4-byte UTF-8, surrogate-pair mishandling or utf8 3-byte limits.
Emoji ZWJ sequence: astral characters joined by U+200D; must not be split or normalised.
Embedded U+0000; C-string truncation would return abc.
Leading and trailing U+0000; trimming or truncation would lose them.
Leading and trailing spaces plus a trailing line break; no strip or trim.
CRLF, LF and bare CR and repeated blank lines kept exactly; no newline translation.
Quote, semicolon, comment marker, LIKE wildcards, backslash: must be bound as parameters and returned unchanged.
Leading U+FEFF byte order mark inside text; drivers must not strip it.

Same sentence with ASCII digits; must stay distinct from the native-digit case.
Native and ASCII digits interleaved in one turn; no digit folding.
One observed turn holding Devanagari words and Latin text; mixed-script text stored as-is, no language claim about the Latin words.
Lone nukta, vowel sign U and candrabindu with no base letter; must not be dropped or reordered.
Leading and trailing spaces, danda (U+0964), tab and CRLF around Devanagari; no trimming.

Plain Tamil call-setting sentence with pulli; baseline round trip.
KA + two-part vowel sign O (U+0BCA); canonically equal to the next case (U+0BC6 U+0BBE), bytes differ.
KA + U+0BC6 + U+0BBE; canonically equal to the precomposed case, bytes differ; must stay distinct.
Tamil digits U+0BE6..U+0BEF; no folding to ASCII.
One observed turn with Tamil words and Latin text; mixed-script text stored as-is, no language claim about the Latin words.
Plain Kannada call-setting sentence; baseline round trip.
KA + vowel sign O (U+0CCA); canonically equal to the next case (U+0CC6 U+0CC2, per the Unicode character database), bytes differ.
KA + U+0CC6 + U+0CC2; canonically equal to the precomposed case, bytes differ; must stay distinct.
Kannada words followed by a Latin email address in one turn; mixed-script text stored as-is.
Plain Malayalam call-setting sentence containing an atomic chillu (U+0D7B); baseline round trip.
Word ending in atomic chillu N (U+0D7B); no canonical decomposition, so NFC must leave it, and it must stay distinct from the ZWJ sequence.

NA + virama + ZWNJ; third distinct spelling of the word ending, ZWNJ must survive.
KA + vowel sign O (U+0D4A); canonically equal to the next case (U+0D46 U+0D3E), bytes differ.
KA + U+0D46 + U+0D3E; canonically equal to the precomposed case, bytes differ; must stay distinct.
Malayalam digits U+0D66..U+0D6F after a lone virama (U+0D4D); a lone combining mark plus native digits.
